items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I used to gig with his band

ctx.x: Back to school, and after school you went to New York and went to W.C. Handy and went nowhere. Then what happened?

Then... Let's see, I left out a period in Atlantic City when I was still going to school. I ran into a guy... There's always a guy like this in every young musician's life, I guess, who gets the young musicians and doesn't pay them. Banjo Bernie was such a guy. And I used to gig with his band, and he'd promise all kind of things, and some nights we'd get three bucks and some nights nothing. But it was just fun, and I have no regrets; the experience was wonderful. So he took us to Philadelphia, I remember, and we…
